title: Scalar preservation for a functor lifted through a linear localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$ be preadditive $R$-linear categories [def-weil-linear-category], and let $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an additive $R$-linear localization at a class $W$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$ be an additive $R$-linear functor [def-weil-linear-functor]. If $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ is a functor with a natural isomorphism $QG\cong F$, then $G(r\alpha)=rG(\alpha)$ for every $r\in R$ and every morphism $\alpha$ of $\mathcal D$.

source.place: Localization.functor_linear_iff, lines 66–95, declaration line 79; read all hypotheses
